precepts.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth. And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit. The high ones that are on high is talking about what? There was war in heaven. The high ones on high are the people ruling. The Lord is going to punish Europe and America. And the kings of the earth too.
precepts.point: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him. Who deceived the world is not just a spiritual demon. This is his children. The white man, Edom, Lucifer, that transformed himself into an angel of light.
precepts.why:
This explains the war in heaven: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth. And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit.” The high ones that are on high are the people ruling. The Lord is going to punish Europe and America, and the kings of the earth too. The gathering into the pit goes into Revelation 20.

Isaiah 34 shows what heaven means. “For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies”: in Revelation their armies are called his angels. “he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.” “And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll.” “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” Is this heaven paradise? No. This heaven is the governments of this world, and the sword comes down upon Idumea, Edom, the people of his curse.

So the dragon in Revelation 12 is Edom, the fourth beast, also called the Devil and Satan. That war in heaven is Christ fighting with the white man and his armies: Lucifer falling from heaven: how art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer. “neither was their place found any more in heaven”: they have no rulership any more on this earth. And the one “which deceiveth the whole world” is not just a spiritual demon; it's his children, the white man, Edom, Lucifer, that transformed himself into an angel of light.

precepts.text: The Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth. The high ones are America, Europe, and the Europeans in the land calling themselves Jews; the kings of the earth are Iran, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, India, Pakistan, Ethiopia, Sudan. Both get punished.
precepts.point: Every move he makes is to buy time and prolong his rule, because in his mind this house goes on forever. Make sure the Arabs never come together, make sure Iran never gets nuclear capability, bomb them. And once he finishes with the nations he comes for us, the leaders in IUIC, to stop us prophesying and testifying, because once we testify, judgment comes. The laws are already being put in place.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

precepts.why:
This proves who the heavens are in Revelation 12:12. “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high”. The high ones that are on high are the ones ruling the earth today: America and Europe. They are the fourth beast, the red dragon, the spiritual wickedness in high places. The Lord shall punish them for all the evil they are doing, and with them the Europeans living in the land of Israel that say they are Jews.

Then: “and the kings of the earth upon the earth.” The kings of the earth are Iran, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, India, Pakistan, Ethiopia, Sudan. God is going to punish the high ones on high, and he is also going to punish those kings of the earth.

So Revelation 12:12 lines up with it. “rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them” is spoken to the high ones: rejoice now, this is your kingdom, have fun. “Woe to the inhabiters of the earth” is spoken to the kings of the earth, the nations below, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Ethiopia, India, China. The devil comes down on them with great wrath, and in that day the Lord punishes both.

precepts.text: The Lord shall punish the host of the high ones and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
precepts.point: Loss of children and widowhood shall come in one day for the multitude of thy sorceries. Thy wisdom and knowledge have perverted thee, and thou hast said, I am.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
The virgin daughter of Babylon says, “I am, and none else beside me”: I am the one, not the French, not the Arabs; big bad America; my military is in all countries and nobody can do a thing about it. “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: your science, technology and weaponry have perverted you, and now all you do is drop bombs from drones. “Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth”, “and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly.”

Isaiah 24 shows who else is judged with her: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.”

The high ones that are on high are Esau in his pride. And with him the kings of the earth, the other nations upon the earth. All nations will be punished, and there is not a thing they can do about it. If the Israelites got punished, why would you not get punished? You have to be punished too.

So Babylon coming down to sit in the dust is part of that day. The Lord brings down the proud one on high first, and the judgment reaches all the kings of the earth.

points: The Most High makes the earth empty and waste, turns it upside down, and scatters abroad its inhabitants, and it shall be the same with every class of people: priest and people, servant and master, maid and mistress, buyer and seller, lender and borrower, taker and giver of usury. The land shall be utterly emptied and spoiled, for the Most High has spoken this word.

note.label: Isaiah 24: The Earth Made Empty and Turned Upside Down

points: The earth mourns and fades away, the world languishes, and the haughty people of the earth languish, for the earth is defiled under its inhabitants because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, and broken the everlasting covenant. Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, its inhabitants are desolate and burned, and few men are left.

note.label: Isaiah 24: The Earth Made Empty and Turned Upside Down

points: The new wine mourns, the vine languishes, and all the merryhearted sigh as the mirth of the tabrets and the joy of the harp cease. The city of confusion is broken down, every house shut up, and there is a crying for wine in the streets, all joy darkened and the mirth of the land gone, leaving desolation and the gate smitten with destruction.

note.label: Isaiah 24: The Earth Made Empty and Turned Upside Down

points: In the midst of the land among the people it shall be as the shaking of an olive tree and the gleaning of grapes when the vintage is done. A remnant lifts up its voice to sing for the majesty of the Most High and to glorify Him from the sea and the isles, even glory to the righteous, yet the prophet cries of his leanness and of the treacherous dealers who deal very treacherously.

note.label: Isaiah 24: The Earth Made Empty and Turned Upside Down

points: Fear, the pit, and the snare are upon the inhabitant of the earth, so that he who flees the noise of the fear falls into the pit, and he who comes up from the pit is taken in the snare, for the windows on high are open and the foundations of the earth shake. The earth is utterly broken down, clean dissolved, moved exceedingly, reeling to and fro like a drunkard, its transgression heavy upon it so that it falls and rises not again.

note.label: Isaiah 24: The Earth Made Empty and Turned Upside Down

points: In that day the Most High shall punish the host of the high ones on high and the kings of the earth upon the earth, gathering them together as prisoners in the pit and shutting them up in the prison, to be visited after many days. Then the moon shall be confounded and the sun ashamed when the Most High of hosts reigns in mount Zion and in Jerusalem, before His ancients gloriously.
